description: background-clip: text on a block, an inline element and wrapped lines, with the shorthand, a gradient and a blend mode, and the colour cut to the clip of the bottom layer

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 540px; height: 190px; background-color: #ffffff; } .b, .q { position: absolute; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 50px; box-sizing: border-box; } .b { width: 100px; height: 60px; } .q { width: 100px; height: 60px; } .i { display: inline; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; } .p0 { left: 20px; top: 20px; background-image: linear-gradient(#d05040, #d05040); -webkit-background-clip: text; color: transparent; } .p1 { left: 150px; top: 20px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #d05040, #4070d0); background-clip: text; color: transparent; } .p2 { left: 280px; top: 20px; background: linear-gradient(#d05040, #d05040) text; color: transparent; } .p3 { left: 410px; top: 20px; background-color: #8080ff; background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(208, 80, 64), rgb(208, 80, 64)), linear-gradient(rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5)); background-clip: text; background-blend-mode: multiply, normal; color: transparent; } .p4 { left: 20px; top: 110px; } .i4 { background-image: linear-gradient(#d05040, #d05040); -webkit-background-clip: text; color: transparent; } .p5 { left: 150px; top: 110px; width: 70px; line-height: 38px; background-image: linear-gradient(#d05040, #d05040); background-clip: text; color: transparent; } .p6 { left: 280px; top: 110px; border: 8px solid transparent; padding: 8px; background-color: #40a060; background-clip: padding-box; } .p7 { left: 410px; top: 110px; background-color: #4070d0; background-image: linear-gradient(#d05040, #d05040); background-clip: text; color: #202020; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 1.34% of the pixels differ by more than 24 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. What is left is the antialiasing along the edge of the glyphs, as in the other text fixtures. It covers background-clip: text on a block, on an inline element and on wrapped lines, with the -webkit- form, the shorthand, a gradient, a blend mode over a layer and the colour, and the colour cut to the clip of the bottom layer. With the text clip ignored the same fixture measures 28.55%, so it fails.
